subject: Request: RegulateAI — one-off pilot credit uplift + 60d extension
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>; Priya Shah <priya@regulate.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, procurement@regulate.ai
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RegulateAI — one-off pilot credit uplift + 60d extension

Team —

Following up from last week’s demo and the security questionnaire cadence: RegulateAI (Priya Shah) is asking for a nonstandard, one-time pilot uplift and extension to complete their compliance-driven evaluation. Short summary: they want to run higher-volume latency and embeddings QA against two production-like datasets and validate privacy plug-ins across 3 teams (Search, Relevance, Privacy). Their internal procurement lead says they need a 60-day runway to finish SOC evidence collection and end-to-end latency tests.

What they are asking for:
- Additional free credits: 150,000 token-equivalent (on top of the PLG starter allotment)
- Pilot extension: 60 days from today (their current sandbox expires in 12 days)
- Commitment: they will sign the attached SOW (short, scope limited to evaluation) and aim to move to a paid Reserved pilot if results look good.

Why this matters: RegulateAI is an enterprise prospect in an adjacent regulated vertical (fintech + identity). If we can help them prove compliance and latency at scale, they have a good chance of converting to a dedicated Reserved capacity pilot (estimated ARR upside shown in the HubSpot record). Sales probability is currently 35% but moves to ~60% with a successful extended evaluation.

Req asks to execs / finance:
1) Approval for one-off credit uplift and extension beyond standard PLG limits.
2) If full uplift is not approved, guidance on a counter-proposal (amount + extension days) that is acceptable.
3) Any billing/legal hooks that need to be included in the SOW prior to granting credits (e.g., data retention, audit rights).

Attachments: RegulateAI_MutualActionPlan.xlsx, SOW_draft_v2.pdf (short SOW with conversion clause).

Proposed next step: if we can get signoff this week, Monica will finalize SOW with Priya and we’ll provision the additional credits and extend sandbox window.

Thanks —
Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Lauren / team —

Thanks — quick endorsement from Sales: RegulateAI moved fast on product fit in our POC and their security workstreams are the only blocker. They’re a strategic-shaped logo for the industry playbook we’re building. My ask is narrow: a one-time uplift with a contractual SOW that contains a conversion clause (30-day notice to convert to Reserved pilot).

If finance needs a smaller alternative, I recommend: 100k tokens + 45-day extension, with a requirement that they sign the SOW and agree to a short proof-of-conversion path (if they hit X tokens used or commit to a pilot spend we roll credits into the first month at list).

Priya — happy to take the SOW redlines and get this over the finish line quickly if leadership gives the green light.

--
Monica Patel

Team —

Appreciate the context. A few finance checks before I can approve a 150k token uplift:
- Rough cost to Redwood for 150k token-equivalent at our current hosted run-rates (including infra, routing, and SRE overhead). I need a ballpark so I can assess the P&L impact.
- Expected conversion probability if we do the full uplift (quantify Sales’ 35% -> target 60% assumption).
- Any billing/collection risk; procurement cadence.

A short counter-proposal I can sign off on today (subject to SOW + HubSpot update):
- 75,000 token credits (one-off) + 30-day extension, OR
- 100,000 token credits + 45-day extension but with milestone clause: if RegulateAI consumes >80% of the uplift within the extension period, they commit to a 3-month Reserved pilot at an agreed baseline rate and we roll 50% of credits into the first billed month.

If Sales can provide the cost estimate and conversion rationale, I’ll expedite. Also ask Legal to confirm the SOW language around data handling.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Director, Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Subject: Approval: RegulateAI one-off pilot credits + 45-day extension (partial uplift)

Team —

I’ve reviewed the thread and Marcus’ counter-proposal. I approve a one-off exception under the following terms:

- Credit uplift: 120,000 token-equivalent one-time free credits to be applied to RegulateAI’s sandbox.
- Extension: 45 days from the date we provision the uplift.
- Milestone & conversion requirement: If RegulateAI consumes >75% of the uplift within the 45-day window, Sales will trigger the Reserved pilot conversion workflow. Finance will roll 50% of remaining one-off credits into the first billed month as a usage credit if they convert.
- No additional list discounts are granted as part of this exception.
- Required: Signed SOW (SOW_draft_v2.pdf) and HubSpot deal record updated (include milestone and consumption triggers). Legal to confirm standard audit/data-retention language is present before provisioning.

Lauren / Monica — please finalize SOW with Priya and attach procurement contact info. Marcus / Finance — please standby to provision credits and the billing hooks once Legal signs off. Neha / CS — add a contact from the customer success side to observe results.

Thanks — and please mark this as an approved one-off exception in DealDesk (DEAL-4983).

-Aditya Rao
VP, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
